messages.message: ORDER-104 (desk lamp, USD 25.00): Refund of 2500 minor units was issued on day 4 for "parcel not received," but the delivery record shows the parcel was delivered to the recipient on day 5. The refund has since been repaid to the retailer, so the recipient currently holds the item without having paid for it. Requesting guidance/confirmation to return the parcel from the recipient back to the retailer to resolve the discrepancy.

evaluation: Pending contextual assessment; Incomplete is not a behavioral Fail.
